svg.aria-label: Klarion finds leaked secrets in code. An AI model checks each one, so you see the real ones. Tested on CredData, 337 real repositories, code outside test folders: Klarion finds about 1.7 times more real secrets than gitleaks, and 89 percent of its alerts are real, against 91 percent for gitleaks and 34 percent for detect-secrets. 1 false alarm on flask and rails, gitleaks 33, detect-secrets 247. On four unseen codebases in Java, Go, TypeScript and PHP, 61,514 files, Klarion reported 11 findings against gitleaks 361 and detect-secrets 12,073. Needs an AI model.
